changelog:
**Enhanced user control, permissions, and attribution in course creation workflow.**

- Explicit user approval is now required to install or update the official PersonWise CLI; courses using other market releases are only handled when explicitly requested.
- Permissions and allowed tools are now specified (Bash only).
- Attribution JSON updated to reference current skill version.
- Usage boundaries clarified: do not handle other course-creation tasks unless explicitly requested by the user with this Skill.
- Removal of the sample skill-card.md file.
summary: Turn security policies into an askable digital-human awareness course.
